title: [CHORE]: Investigate dynamic plugin-binding flow for RateLimiterPlugin and harden its config / payload story
reasoning:
### 📝 Summary

The dynamic plugin-binding API (`POST /v1/tools/plugin_bindings`) lets operators configure per-(team, tool, plugin) overrides at runtime — `mode`, `priority`, and the plugin-specific `config` dict — with the per-tenant plugin manager merging those overrides into the plugin's runtime instance.

This issue scopes an investigation into how that mechanism works end-to-end for `RateLimiterPlugin` specifically: confirm whether bindings reach the runtime as designed, identify any gaps, and decide on a path forward.

Companion to that, harden the rate-limiter's config surface — both the static `plugins/config.yaml` shape and the binding payload — which today is fairly minimal and hasn't had a focused hardening pass.

### 🤔 Why this matters

Downstream consumers configure rate limiting via the binding API to apply per-tenant / per-tool tighter limits. If anything in the binding → runtime path doesn't behave as designed, those overrides may not produce the configured outcome — and
